in_sanskrit.name: Radhansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Radhansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Radhansh is derived from Sanskrit and Hindu culture. It is a combination of two words - Radha and Ansh. Radha means wealth, prosperity, and abundance. Ansh means presence or form. Together, Radhansh means the Lord of Wealth or the One who brings prosperity and abundance in life.
